senses.definition: a heavy iron lever with one end forged into a wedge
to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open
examples: Raccoons managed to pry the lid off the garbage pail
Don't pry into my personal matters!

senses.definition: search or inquire in a meddlesome way
examples: This guy is always nosing around the office

senses.definition: make an uninvited or presumptuous inquiry
examples: They pried the information out of him

senses.definition: a heavy iron lever with one end forged into a wedge

examples: he flipped through my letters in his nosy way
the snoopy neighbor watched us all day

senses.definition: in a curious and prying manner
examples: ‘Do you have a boyfriend?’ she asked her prospective tenant pryingly
